Running in this browser

BM25 keyword search, concept-expanded bag-of-words vectors, cosine similarity, rank fusion and verbatim source extraction. No LLM or external vector database runs in browser mode.

No API keyInspect every score

Python service included

LangGraph orchestration, LlamaIndex chunking, Qdrant vector storage, OpenAI embeddings and generation. Offline mode uses deterministic hashed vectors and extractive answers.

Local run instructionsOptional live mode
Demo boundary

This is a single-user engineering demonstrator. Prompt-pattern checks are illustrative, not comprehensive security. A production deployment needs authenticated tenant filtering, operational monitoring, adversarial testing and a reviewed evaluation set. RAGAS and DeepEval adapters are included in the project; their results are not claimed here.
